title: Table lamp base and stem
prompt: Table lamp base and stem, printed separately and glued together. Base: 120 mm diameter; the bottom 15 mm is straight-sided, then it tapers conically up to a 32 mm diameter flat top at 30 mm height. In the top there's a 20.4 mm socket, 15 mm deep, for the stem, and an 8 mm cable hole straight down through the middle from the socket floor to the bottom. Stem: a 20 mm tube, 250 mm long, with an 8 mm bore for the cable. Model them assembled: base on Z = 0 centred on the Z axis, the stem standing in the socket on the socket floor.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Assembled: 120 mm across, 265 mm tall (the stem stands 15 mm deep in the socket)
The base: 120 mm diameter x 30 mm, centred on the Z axis
Base volume π·76279.4 ≈ 239639 mm³ ±0.05%: a 20.4 socket (a 20.0 one adds 190 mm³) and the 8 mm cable hole
The stem: 20 mm x 250 mm, on the axis, standing on the socket floor at Z = 15
The stem is a tube with an 8 mm cable bore: π·(10² − 4²)·250 ≈ 65973 mm³ ±0.5%
The base tapers: one conical face
Five cylindrical faces: base rim, socket, cable hole; stem outside and bore

notes: Base = π·60²·15 + frustum(60→16, h 15) − socket π·10.2²·15 − cable hole π·4²·15 = π·76279.4 (frustum π·h/3·(R1² + R1R2 + R2²)). The socket clearance is only visible in the base volume, hence the tight tolerance: every base dimension is given in the prompt.
